elements.name: conclusion-copy
elements.text: Both policies produced valid decisions from identical initial evidence. Rules reached the client sooner and were accepted in 9/9 scenarios, compared with 1/9 for the LLM. Further work should align policy decisions with survey video endings and test delivery on new live encounters.
